children: Starco Brands entered into an Omnibus First Amendment to its loan agreement to reduce borrowing costs. Effective September 29, 2026 and executed October 7, 2026, the amendment lowers the Applicable Margin on the term loans and line of credit to 4.25% from 5.5% until maturity. The change applies across the existing loan agreement and related promissory notes with Pasadena Private Lending. Management expects the reduced rate to decrease interest expense and improve liquidity.
: Omnibus First Amendment to loan agreement and promissory notes
: Reduce interest expense and enhance financial flexibility
